name: daemon
description: Run Claude Code as a persistent systemd user service via tmux — auto-restarts on crash, survives logout, remote-controllable from claude.ai. Opt in per project with a .claude/daemon.json (sessionName/remoteLabel naming, settings overrides). Reaps leaked/orphaned background processes the session spawned, optionally kills stalled/hung ones, keeps Claude current by running `claude update` and restarting idle sessions to adopt it, and keeps OAuth auth alive so remote control survives long idle periods without re-login.
